description: Defines the class PermissionSubjectsMap, a thread-unsafe Java class representing a weighted binary relation between permissions and authorization subjects, with methods for relation manipulation and analysis.

classes.name: PermissionSubjectsMap
classes.description: A thread-unsafe Java class modeling a weighted N-to-N relation between permissions and subjects, with methods for adding, removing, copying, and querying relations.

methods.name: addTotalRelationOfWeightZero
methods.description: Adds a total relation between given permissions and subject IDs with all weights set to zero.

methods.name: getMaxWeightForAllPermissions
methods.description: Returns the maximum weight among related permission-subject pairs for given permissions and subject IDs.

methods.name: getMaxNonemptyWeightForAllPermissions
methods.description: Returns the maximum weight among related permission-subject pairs where all permissions are related to some of the given subject IDs.

methods.name: getSubjectUnion
methods.description: Returns the union of subjects related to any of the given permissions, with maximum weights.

methods.name: getSubjectIntersect
methods.description: Returns the intersection of subjects related to all of the given permissions, with maximum weights.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the relation.

methods.name: copyWithIncrementedWeight
methods.description: Creates a copy of the relation with each weight incremented by 1.

methods.name: copyWithDecrementedWeight
methods.description: Creates a copy of the relation with each weight decremented by 1.

methods.name: removeAllEntriesFrom
methods.description: Removes all permission-subject pairs present in another relation from this relation.

methods.name: addAllEntriesFrom
methods.description: Unions another relation into this one, taking maximum weights for overlapping pairs.
